referencePolicy.purpose: Use the user-supplied real amusement-park ship photos as mechanism, proportion, loading-platform and lighting reference. Do not literally copy branding, painted artwork, people, surroundings or ticketing.
referencePolicy.designIntent: A colorful Viking-themed travelling-fair pendulum ride: very tall open A-frame, blue square outer steel, yellow inner bracing, raised white loading platform, deep brown longship, red/black/white Viking fascia and a separate blinking-light overlay compatible with the City Horizon Ferris-wheel family.

geometry.clearancePolicy: Raise pivot and lengthen hangers by the same amount so loading height stays approximately unchanged while swing-end ground clearance increases.

animation.note: Geometry and swing-clearance are being approved first. Final swing arc, frame count and FPS remain undefined. Static A-frame/base never rotate; SwingPivot owns the hangers and boat.

motionOverlay.note: Final swing animation is defined only after this visual/mechanical proxy is approved.

idleLightOverlay.note: Bulb locations are authored now. Blink cadence and final overlay frame count are deferred.

realReferenceObservations: The machine is a tall open A-frame, not a roofed gantry.
The passenger ship hangs low on long arms under a high exposed axle.
Travelling-fair structure uses bright outer legs, contrasting inner truss braces and dense edge lighting.
Loading happens on a raised full-width platform with railings and a side/front staircase.
A large triangular decorative panel fills the far side without occupying the swing plane.
A compact illuminated sign/light box sits above the pivot.
requestedV4Changes: lengthen hangers by the same 2.0 units so the rest/loading height remains approximately unchanged
widen the A-frame feet slightly for the taller structure
thicken primary square steel members for believable scale
review clearance at approximately plus/minus 55 degrees before defining the final animation arc
prototypeNotes.nextGate: Review SOUTH proxy for the taller A-frame and convincing real-ride proportions. After visual approval, render explicit swing-clearance checks before locking the final arc/frame count.
